material.acceptance_criteria: After pointerdown followed by pointercancel, a later pointermove on the canvas does not call centre(); the sequence is covered by a test or live check.
material.description: Fact: js/client/ui_minimap.js:187 sets pressed on pointerdown, and only the window pointerup listener clears it (ui_minimap.js:194). The file has no pointercancel listener (codesearch over js/: 0 hits, dispatch 1792858548708-4738-3ef1ddb916bdf4d3), and the #minimap rule in js/client/play.html:149 sets no touch-action. When the browser cancels a press (pointercancel, not pointerup), pressed stays true, and the next pointermove on the canvas calls centreAt (ui_minimap.js:191-192), moving the camera with no button held. Counterexample: pointerdown on the canvas, pointercancel, then pointermove on the canvas, which calls centre() where it should not. Reproduces on a touch-capable screen that also has a mouse. Distinct from the press-leaves-canvas row OWNERSHIP-trav-minimap-camera-1 and the moba_input.js row illegal-trav-input-client-2.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:187 sets pressed on pointerdown; only the window pointerup listener (:194) clears it; the file has no pointercancel listener. Observable: after a browser-cancelled press (no pointerup), pressed stays true and the next canvas pointermove calls centreAt (:191-193) with no button held, so hovering the minimap moves the camera until any pointerup. Read: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433.

material.subject: A press cancelled by the browser leaves the minimap drag flag set, so hovering the minimap moves the camera with no button down
material.witness: Live Chrome, session verify-HUGHES-trav-minimap-camera-1, sha 8d102946: pointerdown then pointercancel on the canvas then pointermove gives centre calls 1, 1, 1 (no move after cancel). Control at 21508075 (no cancel listener) gave 1, 1, 2 in the same harness. CI: ci workflow success on 8d102946.
material.witness_plan: Dispatch synthetic pointerdown, pointercancel and pointermove on the minimap canvas and count centre() calls; expect 0.
